data.corpus_key: Grim White Stag ~ Cascade of Spears
data.description: 1/day the Stag can shed fragments of its antlers, creating up to 18 +1 shortspears, +1 spears, or +1 longspears in any combination (or substitute five +1 arrows or +1 bolts for each spear). These weapons retain their magic for %1 minutes, after which they become common weapons made of antler.
data.name: Cascade of Spears
